# Commit Messages

Write commit messages in imperative mood and keep them focused on what changed.

## Format

- First line: short summary (prefer <= 72 characters)
- Optional body: explain why the change was made and any important context

## Guidelines

- Use specific verbs (add, fix, refactor, remove, update)
- Mention the affected area/module when helpful
- Avoid vague summaries like "changes" or "updates"

## Example

- `fix(sb-ecom): validate empty cart before checkout`
